description: Test script for checking the status of wwan0 interface and obtaining its IP address in a network device, used within a test automation framework.

classes.name: TDKScriptingLibrary
classes.description: Library class for scripting test cases, providing methods to load modules, create test steps, execute commands, and unload modules.

methods.name: configureTestCase
methods.description: Configures the test case with target IP, port, and test name.

methods.name: getLoadModuleResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of loading a specific module.

methods.name: createTestStep
methods.description: Creates a test step object for executing specific commands or actions.

methods.name: addParameter
methods.description: Adds parameters to a test step, such as commands to execute.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Executes the configured test step and performs the command.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result status of the executed test step.

methods.name: getResultDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed output from the executed command.

methods.name: setResultStatus
methods.description: Sets the pass/fail status of the test step.

methods.name: setLoadModuleStatus
methods.description: Sets the load status of a module.
